nom: The Ordinary Ascorbyl Tetraisopalmitate Solution 20% In Vitamin F

avis.titre: Great job! My before and after 1 month pictures attached.Great job! My before and after 1 month pictures attached.
avis.texte: I bought this solution for $30. Not paid to review this or anything for free. Since this is my one month of using this solution, i think my review can now be very reliable. I have Asian, combination skin. I had a fair amount of blemishes and scars from many old pimples, and random red spots on the cheek and forehead. Lately it has been real bad, maybe due to wearing lots more foundation than before, and living through my first winter in the Northeast (30 degree weather in spring). I bought this Vitamin F solution out of desperation, because my skin has not looked so bad before in my life. The bottle is a dark Amber tint, but I still wanted to be extra safe and taped the outside entirely with duct tape so thathe it's covered away fruv UV light. I feel this hinders the solution from losing its potency. It has been 26 days, and I've used this twice a day, everyday except about 2 days. In the morning I wash my face, towel dry it, put a thin layer of solution on my cheeks, nose and chin, wait >10 minutes for the skin to absorb it, then put on moisturizer. At night, I do the same thing, and sometimes I add a step by using organic rosehip oil on top of the moisturizer. I am showing my BEFORE and 1 MONTH AFTER pictures. Both were taken without any makeup, after the routine I just mentioned. There's no filters in any of them. There's no touch up, just cropping and adding text. I can personally tell a huge difference. Ignore the color tone difference, my skin has not gotten whiter. But

Love this product. It’s an every day staple for me. Morning routine, rinse with just water and smooth a few drops around the face. It is suspended in a very light oil which is perfectly moisturizing. I let it soak in and then apply sunscreen. Never had any irritation, and I can tell there are subtle brightening effects with regular use. I love that it plays double duty as a vitamin C serum and oil moisturizer, and my skin glows! I trust the Ordinary brand to have effective ingredients, and this product is quite a high percentage. You absolutely cannot beat this price for an effective product with ingredient transparency.
This serum gets absorbed into the skin and does not irritate. For me it lightens a spot of dark pigmentation.
Works phenomenally, makes my skin so bright and glow! Smells and feels great and it works great every time. Best value for the price I’ve seen.

avis.titre: Haven’t noticed any lightning of skin discolorations!
avis.texte: Have been using since purchased, haven’t seen any difference yet, but it does absorb quickly.

Unfortunately it causes acne. Even using two drops max I was getting some cystic acne around the cheeks/nose, small cluster bumps on the forehead, and a lot of clogged pores around the jawline. I’m someone who doesn’t really get acne and uses only face wash.

avis.titre: As good as L-ascorbic forms of Vit C but not irritating at all
avis.texte: I have suffered from itchiness/redness using L-ascorbic acid forms of Vit C so thought I'd try THD as it's meant to be great for sensitive skin as well as having all the benefits of deep skin penetration and collagen synthesis stimulation. This product makes my skin look just as bright as the direct forms of Vit C I've used and I have no skin irritation all. It has no smell. It is very lightly oily but I find once it's been on my skin for a minute or so, this sinks in and once covered by moisturiser and SPF, my skin isn't oily at all. I would say to apply your water-based serums before this though as it's oil-based. Price-wise, yes, there are cheaper ones out there, but THD is notoriously expensive so reckon this is a good price. Recommend!
Love these products from The Ordinary I've been using 8 of their products every day. Great results .
Prodotto utile per le macchie ma oleoso, quindi attenzione per le pelli grasse

Ich habe lange mit Pickelmalen gekämpft und viele Produkte ausprobiert. Dieses Vitamin-C-Serum war für mich der perfekte Einstieg, weil es sehr sanft zur Haut ist und meine Haut nicht gereizt hat. 🤍✨ Mit regelmäßiger Anwendung wirkte mein Hautton nach und nach ebenmäßiger und meine Pickelmale wurden mit der Zeit weniger sichtbar. Besonders gefällt mir, dass sich das Serum angenehm auf der Haut anfühlt und sich gut in meine tägliche Pflegeroutine integrieren lässt. Mittlerweile bestelle ich es seit Jahren immer wieder nach und es gehört für mich fest zu meiner Skincare-Routine. Eine klare Empfehlung für alle, die ein sanftes Vitamin-C-Produkt suchen! 🍊💛
